'''Kebok''' is a [[goblin]] [[quest giver]] located in the [[Salty Sailor Tavern]] in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. As the [[Jungle troll|trolls]] have been killing agents in the jungle, Kebok sends adventurers to kill them and bring back their [[Bloodscalp Ear|ears]] and [[Skullsplitter Tusk|tusks]]. Kebok intends on using the tusks as undetectable fake [[tiger]] fangs to export to islands in the [[South Seas]].
